name: Rama X of Thailand
summary: Vajiralongkorn has rarely spoken publicly on politics. His documented political acts are institutional: he sought changes to the 2017 draft constitution on royal powers, took personal control of Crown Property Bureau assets and some army units, and barred his sister from a prime ministerial candidacy. His few recorded remarks, in 2020, expressed love for all Thais and described Thailand as a land of compromise.
